toolbar.speed_limit_on: Speed limit on ({{limit}}) — click to turn off
toolbar.speed_limit_off: Speed limit off — click to turn on

list.load_error_desc: The download engine did not answer. Try again in a moment.
list.refresh_error: The list could not be refreshed.
list.no_results_desc: Search matches file names and links.
list.empty_all_desc: Paste a link, drop one onto this window, or use the browser extension.
list.empty_active_desc: Running and waiting downloads appear here.
list.empty_paused_desc: Paused downloads keep their progress and continue where they stopped.
list.empty_failed_desc: Downloads that could not finish appear here with the reason.
list.empty_archived_desc: Archive finished downloads to tidy the list without deleting files.
list.empty_document_desc: PDFs, office files and texts appear here.
list.empty_archive_desc: ZIP, 7z, RAR and similar files appear here.
list.empty_program_desc: Disk images and installers appear here.

actions.already_queued: This link is already in the list

inspector.label: Details
inspector.speed_limit_hint: Empty or 0 uses the global limit.

status_bar.free_space_hint: Free space on the download volume

confirm.delete_from_disk: Also delete the file from disk
confirm.delete_from_disk_hint: Completed files are deleted permanently, not moved to the Trash.

remove.detail: Unfinished data is deleted. Completed files stay on disk unless you choose otherwise.

refresh.title: Refresh Link
refresh.hint: Paste a fresh link for “{{name}}”. The download continues where it stopped; if the file on the server is different, it starts over.

new_download.title: New Download
new_download.url_placeholder: Paste one or more links — one per line
new_download.invalid_url: Enter a link that starts with http:// or https://.
new_download.cookies_hint: Sent only to the site of the first link and only over HTTPS.
new_download.checksum_hint: SHA-256 or MD5 — verified when the download finishes. A mismatch fails the download.
new_download.import_hint: Import links from a .txt or .csv file (or drop it onto the field)
new_download.import_unsupported: Only .txt and .csv files can be imported.
new_download.import_failed: The file could not be read.

settings.title: Settings
settings.discard_detail: Changes made in this window are not saved.
settings.clipboard_hint: When you copy a link, Falcon DM opens the New Download window.
settings.update_current: Falcon DM {{version}} is up to date.
settings.save_folder_hint: Used for every kind without its own folder.
settings.kind_folders_hint: Optional. Must be inside your home folder.
settings.connections_hint: More connections speed up large files on fast servers. Some servers limit this.
settings.schedule_hint: Outside the window, running downloads wait and continue later. Overnight ranges work.
settings.schedule_invalid: Enter two different times, or turn the schedule off.
settings.completion_hint: Runs once when no active, queued, or paused downloads remain. Failed downloads count as finished.
settings.completion_script_hint: Must be an executable file in your home folder, /opt/homebrew/bin or /usr/local/bin. It runs directly, not through a shell.
settings.proxy_hint: HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy for all downloads. Leave empty for a direct connection.
settings.ytdlp_missing: yt-dlp is not installed. YouTube and DASH downloads need it.
settings.ytdlp_bad_path: The yt-dlp location below does not point to a program.
settings.browser_cookies_label: Let yt-dlp use your Chrome sign-in
settings.browser_cookies_hint: Needed for age-restricted or members-only videos. macOS may ask for permission.
settings.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg not found. Streams cannot be combined into one file.

extension.intro: The extension sends downloads from Chrome or Edge to Falcon DM and lets you pick video quality on the page.
extension.revoke_detail: It can no longer send downloads until you approve it again.
extension.step_open: In Chrome, open chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode.
extension.step_load: Click “Load unpacked” and choose the extension folder inside Falcon DM.
extension.step_pair: Click the extension's icon. It shows a 6-digit code: approve the same code here.

pair.title: Connect browser extension?
pair.body: A browser extension wants to send downloads to Falcon DM. It shows this code:
pair.warning: Approve only if the extension shows exactly the same code.

profiles.intro: Site profiles add a referrer, user agent or cookies to downloads from one site, and can save them in their own subfolder.
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.cookies: Cookies — leave empty to keep the saved ones

onboarding.title: Welcome to Falcon DM
onboarding.subtitle: A fast, quiet download manager for your Mac.
onboarding.f_fast_desc: Large files download over several connections and continue exactly where they stopped.
onboarding.f_video_desc: YouTube, HLS and DASH streams are saved as one ready-to-play file.
onboarding.f_browser_desc: The extension catches downloads and adds a quality picker to video pages.
onboarding.ext_desc: Optional, but it makes downloading from the browser a single click.
onboarding.ext_pending: The extension is waiting — approve its code in the dialog.
onboarding.tools_desc: Video sites need yt-dlp. Falcon DM finds it automatically after installation.

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: What the download engine did recently. Useful when something goes wrong.

app.clipboard_failed: The clipboard could not be read.
app.error_boundary: Something went wrong in this part of the window.

errors.unsupported_magnet: Magnet and torrent links are not supported.
errors.invalid_url: This is not a valid web link.
errors.junk_media_url: This link is a page tracker, not a downloadable file.
errors.private_host: Links to this Mac or the local network are blocked for safety.
errors.disk_full: Not enough free space on the disk.
errors.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg is missing, so the streams could not be combined.
errors.ytdlp_missing: yt-dlp is needed for this site. Install it with “brew install yt-dlp”.
errors.ytdlp_path_invalid: The yt-dlp location in Settings is not valid.
errors.dash_live: Live DASH streams cannot be downloaded.
errors.dash_drm: This DASH stream is protected by DRM and cannot be downloaded.
errors.login_required: The site requires sign-in. Turn on Chrome sign-in in Settings or check the link.
errors.remote_changed: The file changed on the server during the download.
errors.partial_response: The server sent only part of the file. The link may be broken or expired.
errors.content_encoding: The server compressed the response, so the file could not be downloaded.
errors.file_missing: The file is no longer on disk.
errors.error_page: The server sent an error page instead of the file.
errors.empty_file: The server sent an empty file.
errors.checksum_mismatch: The downloaded file does not match the expected checksum.
errors.checksum_invalid: This is not a valid SHA-256 or MD5 checksum.
errors.internal: Falcon DM stopped this download unexpectedly. Try again.
errors.http_forbidden: The server refused access (HTTP {{code}}). The link may need a browser session.
errors.http_not_found: The file is not on the server (HTTP {{code}}).
errors.settings_corrupt: settings.json is damaged. Falcon DM is using defaults and will not overwrite it.
